notes: Play Coach: premoves while the coach thinks, and ←/→ to look back through the game.
Reviews: "Play on from here" continues any of your moves against your coach.
Home: one click to review your last chess.com game, and a monthly review with three next steps.
Progress: patterns in your games (when your mistakes happen, white vs black, time controls, blunders in losses).
Puzzle Rush: new "My weak spots" mode on this week's focus theme.
Guess the move: replay your own lost games and find better moves, judged by Stockfish.
Analysis → My games: your opening gaps, with one click to add the best move to Memory.
Endgames: lessons by level with your next lesson suggested.
Polish: offline notice, a Report button when something breaks (secrets are masked), Auto and High-contrast themes, clear keyboard focus, and screen-reader friendly puzzle and coach messages.
